System.assert(!iterator.hasNext()); locator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds(queryText, binds, AccessLevel.USER_MODE); iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); Account located = (Account)iterator.next(); System.assertEquals('Query-One', located.Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext()); locator = Database.getQueryLocatorWithBinds(queryText, binds, AccessLevel.SYSTEM_MODE); iterator = locator.iterator(); System.assert(iterator.hasNext()); System.assertEquals('Query-One', ((Account)iterator.next()).Name); System.assert(!iterator.hasNext());
